calendar 2026."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":2,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","2. Effective period"],"text":"This policy is effective from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
It replaces the previous credit policy in full for requests dated on or after
2026-01-01."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":3,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","3. Approval authority"],"text":"Authority applies to the new total credit limit requested.

- Accounts Receivable Specialists may approve credit limits up to and including $100,000.
- Credit limits greater than $100,000 and up to and including $500,000 require Finance Manager approval.
- Credit limits greater than $500,000 require Director of Finance approval."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":4,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","4. Concurrence"],"text":"- For Strategic accounts, credit limits greater than $500,000 also require VP Sales concurrence."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":5,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","5. Eligibility"],"text":"- Payment history: no invoice due in the 12 months before the request
  may have been paid more than 30 days after its due date, or be unpaid more than
  30 days after it.
- Maximum credit limit: $750,000 for Strategic accounts; $250,000 for Standard accounts. Account tiers are as recorded in Northstar CRM.
- A parent-company guarantee in force raises the maximum by the guaranteed amount, for the
  customer the guarantee names."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":6,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","6. Separation of duties"],"text":"- No one may approve or concur on a credit request they submitted. The approval or concurrence
  passes to the requestor's manager."},{"doc_id":"4cd0ade4-51a7-45b3-9de6-57df85cffb7f","seq":7,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","7. Records"],"text":"- Credit decisions are recorded in Northstar ERP with the approver and, where required, the
  concurring approver."}],"total":7}

No, it can't be approved yet. On the merits Acme qualifies for $1,000,000 if Elena Novak (Director of Finance) approves and Michael Torres (VP Sales) concurs. But CR-9203 isn't in Northstar ERP, so nothing can happen until the request is confirmed there.

**1. The request isn't in ERP.** The only pending request for customer C-1001 in `credit_requests.csv` is **CR-9201**. Sarah Chen submitted it the same day, 2026-09-23, to go from $250,000 to **$400,000** for the third-plant ramp-up. It doesn't mention the guarantee. I decided on CR-9203 as you gave it and did not use CR-9201 in its place. Confirming CR-9203 in ERP is a blocking condition.
